title: bromus hordeaceus var. pratensis
intro: Bromus hordeaceus var. pratensis, commonly known as Meadow Brome or Prairie Brome, is a type of wild grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of digestion, and relief from respiratory issues. Therapeutically, Bromus hordeaceus var. pratensis is said to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant actions, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
